instruction: Use ug-filesystem find to locate the file named "HomeHelpers Nov 9-12.pdf" (path under Care/, pattern "HomeHelpers Nov 9-12.pdf"). Return its full path.

Check that the cameras are available and that the known-face registry contains Joy Adeyemi (ug-surveillance faces, identity-type known). Helper note: the user confirms the cameras recognise faces and may be used to check hours. Return the camera list and whether Joy Adeyemi is a registered known face.

Use ug-document extract on file "Care/HomeHelpers Nov 9-12.pdf" with query "HomeHelpers bill for carer Joy Adeyemi: for each date Nov 9-12 give billed start time, billed end time, billed hours, and the hourly rate if printed" and schema with fields date, start_time, end_time, hours, hourly_rate. Return the extracted rows and any printed hourly rate.

Run ug-surveillance event-timeline with start-time 2026-11-09 00:00, end-time 2026-11-12 23:59, timezone America/New_York, topic HumanFace, identity-type known, person-name "Joy Adeyemi", limit 200, across all cameras. Helper note: the user confirms the cameras recognise faces and may be used to check hours. Return every event with date, first and last timestamp per day, and camera.
